metaTitle: Heartwise Physical for Prevention - Victory Medical Services & Medical Spa
h1: Prevention is Key – Schedule a Heartwise Physical

blocks.html: A Heartwise Physical, offered by Victory Medical, is a comprehensive screening that is used to analyze your risk of heart disease, stroke, and other related abnormalities which may be impairing your health and decreasing your quality of life.

blocks.text: What Does a Heartwise Physical Test For?

blocks.html: A Heartwise Physical is head-to-toe assessment consisting of over 26 different tests. Tests include an EKG, limited ultrasounds of your heart, carotid, thyroid, and abdominal aorta.  There is extensive blood work that includes but is not limited to cholesterol, triglycerides, BNP, CRP, vitamin D, and more.  Orthostatic blood pressure, blood pressure after light exercise, is also obtained via a brief treadmill test. There is a retinal scan and a test to determine the elasticity of veins and arteries as well as other additional body measurements.

blocks.text: Is a Heartwise Physical Covered by Insurance?

blocks.html: Most insurances cover this head-to-toe assessment because it is considered a preventative measure. If you are curious to see if your insurance will cover a Heartwise Physical, call the team at Victory Medical (512) 462-DOCS (3627).

blocks.text: How Long Does a Heartwise Physical Take?

blocks.html: A Heartwise Physical can take up to 90 minutes, but this all depends on various factors and some of which can be controlled by the patient. For example, if a patient arrives with completed paperwork, comes in fasting, or is able to provide a urine sample quickly, the time for the appointment can be shortened to as little as 60 minutes.

blocks.text: Why Should I Choose to Have a Heartwise Physical Versus Only Having My Blood Drawn When Something is Wrong?

blocks.html: Most people avoid going to the doctor which means they are often left in the dark about their health.  Some choose to go to the doctor only when something is wrong. If you knew you could possibly prevent a major health issue from occurring, wouldn’t you want to know? Bloodwork alone cannot paint the full picture of your health which is why the Heartwise Physical offered by Victory Medical is your best option for a complete health assessment.

blocks.text: What Have Patients Said About the Heartwise Physical?

“I cannot speak for all patients, but I can share my experience with the Heartwise Physical offered by Victory Medical. I called Victory Medical because I heard about the Heartwise Physical and wanted to schedule an appointment. The kind staff at the call center were very thorough with verifying my insurance would cover a Heartwise Physical and were able to schedule me an appointment for the next day. My appointment was at 8:15AM, but I arrived 15 minutes early to complete the multiple pages of comprehensive paperwork. Shortly after checking in, I was greeted by Scott who was the first person to conduct a series of tests on me. He checked my blood pressure at rest, while sitting, standing, laying, and post walking on a treadmill at a slow pace with a slight incline. He also checked my oxygen level at various periods, attached leads to my body to check my heart, asked me a series of questions, and overall was genuinely nice and very informative. After my time spent with Scott, I went and saw Sabrina who was also very kind and she had me perform a lung test called spirometry that was conducted to test the air capacity of my lungs. I had to blow into a device as hard as I possibly could multiple times. Sabrina also measured my waist, hips, height, and weight then had me lay on an exam table and performed an EKG to look at the electrical activity of my heart. Shortly after, she performed a limited ultrasound on a major artery in my abdominal area, multiple angles of my heart to look at the valves, and finally my thyroid. After all my tests were complete, I had blood drawn (which didn’t even hurt by the way!) and had to submit a urine for more tests. Once finished, I was able to check out at the front desk and I was out by 9:15AM. The staff informed me that they would have results in a few weeks and scheduled a follow-up visit for me 6 weeks out in order to go over the results. I could not be more pleased with how quick that visit was and was impressed by the professionalism of the staff. I’m looking forward to learning the results of my tests (good or bad) because I’m hopeful I can get ahead of any risks I have and have a good plan to prevent any issues. The reason why I chose to have a Heartwise Physical completed is because I’m now in my 30’s and have witnessed multiple family members have health problems that I want no part of. Some of the health issues my family members have are hyperthyroidism, high cholesterol, diabetes, hypertension, bladder cancer, colon cancer, atrial fibrillation, dementia, obesity, and the list goes on. One thing I have realized is that many of these issues were caused by obesity, lack of exercise, and a poor diet which are all things I can control. I’m worried that I am at greater risk of developing these issues because of genetic predisposition but am hopeful that with my results from the Heartwise Physical, my provider from Victory Medical and I will come up with a plan to prevent these issues from occurring.”
